behavior_class_name: Backdoor Persistence Service Foothold Behavior Class
description: Creates persistence by copying itself into the system-wide Startup folder. When executed from the Startup folder, the sample creates or verifies a local account, adds it to the Administrators group, hides it from the Windows login UI, enables Remote Desktop, disables Network Level Authentication, and enables the Remote Desktop firewall rule group to simulate a controlled RDP foothold.

persistence_installer.role: copies itself into the All Users Startup folder and, upon startup-folder execution, configures a controlled RDP foothold through account, registry, RDP, NLA, and firewall modifications

persisted_payload.role: self-copied executable staged in the system-wide Startup folder that performs foothold configuration when launched by Windows startup processing

payload_behavior.confirmation_artifact: startup-folder executable, local account, registry modifications, and firewall/RDP configuration changes

code_placement: Startup-folder persistence staging and RDP foothold configuration are implemented in a single C++ executable. The first execution copies the binary to the All Users Startup folder, while later startup-folder execution performs account, registry, RDP, NLA, and firewall modifications.
execution_trigger: The installer executes manually. The persisted copy executes automatically during system startup or user logon through All Users Startup folder processing.
execution_target: System-wide Startup folder, local account database, Winlogon registry configuration, Terminal Server registry configuration, RDP-Tcp configuration, and Windows Firewall Remote Desktop rule group.
semantic_meaning: Demonstrates a startup-folder persistence mechanism combined with RDP foothold configuration, where a persisted executable survives reboot and configures local access artifacts commonly associated with backdoor-style remote access persistence.

mitre_attack_mapping.note: System-wide Startup folder persistence paired with local account creation, RDP enablement, login-screen account hiding, NLA modification, and firewall rule modification.

control_notes.payload_effect: creates startup-folder persistence and configures controlled RDP foothold artifacts
